Sibuna v0.3.1 is a patch release for v0.3.0. It fixes a cluster restart failure and adds the
missing mingw-w64 runtime notices to the Windows package. Request inspection, CRS behaviour,
storage schemas and wire protocols are unchanged from v0.3.0.

Fixes:
- A restarting cluster node could exit with StorageUnavailable about two seconds after start.
  Its first GeoIP metadata read went through the cluster database while the node was still
  electing a leader, and that single read was fatal. Console startup now retries unavailable
  GeoIP reads within the same 30-second bound used for the CRS restore. This was the
  intermittent restart failure seen during v0.3.0 qualification.
- Windows archives now include the mingw-w64 runtime notices (ZPL-2.1 and gdtoa). Each
  archive carries only the C runtime notices its executable links: musl for Linux, mingw-w64
  for Windows.
- `sibuna --help` no longer describes CRS integration as pending release qualification.
- vendor/README.md lists every local change to the vendored Paxos and Zaxonlite sources.

Qualification:
- The unchanged three-host CRS scenario (selection, leader loss, quorum refusal, restart
  restoration, rollback) failed on its first run with the v0.3.0 cluster build. With the fix
  it passed 12 consecutive runs on separate hosts. In 25 node starts a transient storage
  failure was retried and the node then served its console.
- The full native suite and console browser tests pass: 95 of 95 build steps and 1,174 of
  1,174 tests.
- The release workflow builds and checks every packaged executable before publication.
- Benchmarks and the FTW corpus results in the v0.3.0 notes still apply, because the request
  path is unchanged.

Downloads:
- Linux x86-64 and ARM64: statically linked musl builds; Linux 5.10 or later.
- macOS Apple Silicon and Intel: macOS 15 or later; unsigned command-line builds.
- Windows x86-64: native sibuna.exe; Windows 10 / Server 2019 or later.

Archives include the executable, README, full license texts, dependency notices and an exact
build manifest. SHA256SUMS covers every archive. Engine sources are LGPL-3.0; console
sources, including the Wasm interface, are AGPL-3.0. The combined executable is AGPL-covered.
CRS rules are Apache-2.0 and are downloaded and verified at runtime, not bundled.
Corresponding source and build scripts are in this release's tag and linked from the console.
Companies seeking alternative licensing can contact the authors, Vikrant Rathore and
Ronak Rathore. Third-party libraries remain subject to their respective licenses.

The shipped builds include storage and console support; the console starts only with --console.
Multi-node deployments require a separate -Dcluster=true build with OpenSSL 3. No GeoIP address
database is bundled; use the documented CLI import/update commands for your chosen dataset.

Upgrading from v0.3.0 needs no migration. The v0.3.0 release notes describe that release's
behaviour changes and limits, which still apply:
https://github.com/insanai/sibuna/releases/tag/v0.3.0

Documentation: https://insanai.github.io/sibuna/
Deployment guide: https://insanai.github.io/sibuna/book/operations.html
Source: https://github.com/insanai/sibuna/tree/v0.3.1
